$comment: The manual-validation ledger: every check a machine cannot run, and where
Automated gates are self-recording — CI is either green or it is not. The
checks that need a phone, a mushaf, or a pair of ears have no such memory:
they get done once, written into a decision record in prose, and then nobody
can answer 'is that still true, and on what device, and when?' without
reading four documents. This file is that answer, in one place a gate can
The point is not bookkeeping. It is that a manual result should end up
tightening something automated — a threshold, a fixture, a new gate — so the
expensive check does not have to be repeated to stay true. That is what the
`tunes` field records: what this verdict is allowed to change. An entry whose
`tunes` is empty is a check we are paying for and not banking.
blocks:  roadmap items that cannot proceed until this is `done`
tunes:   the automated artifact this result feeds (threshold, fixture, gate)
staleAfterDays: for repeating checks — how long a `done` result stays valid
before the gate asks for it again. Omit for one-shot checks.

checks.title: On-device pan/zoom + highlight-toggle verdict
checks.why: The emulated baseline (~8.3 ms/frame, flat under CPU throttle) structurally cannot see the two real risks: initial raster of a ~170 KB inline SVG on a low-end phone, and re-raster on zoom past the layer's backing store. The rendering-scale decision for 604 pages rests on this and nothing else.
checks.how: make phone-perf → open the printed LAN URL on a real mid/low-tier Android and an older iPhone → tap ابدأ and follow the bar for 15s (pan, pinch, tap ayahs) → long-press the JSON it prints and paste it into this entry's `result`. No cable and no DevTools: the phone measures itself with a rAF sampler (apps/web/src/perf/probe.ts), because the old recipe — pair over USB, enable Web Inspector, find the timeline — is why this check sat open for six loops. Run it twice where you can, once as a browser tab and once from the Home Screen install; the JSON stamps which. The DevTools route still works if you want a flame chart: `make phone` serves the same build without the probe.
checks.decides: inline-SVG everywhere | content-visibility virtualization | raster-glyph fallback
tunes: apps/web/perf/pan-zoom-trace.mjs — the frame budget asserted in CI becomes the measured number, not the emulated one
docs/PLAN.md §Loop 4b — which of the three rendering strategies gets built

checks.title: VoiceOver / TalkBack gesture walkthrough
checks.why: axe and the keyboard hop tour cover the machine-checkable floor and are green, but neither can tell you whether a screen-reader user can actually select an ayah and hop. Per-polygon labels are a design bet that has never been heard out loud.
checks.how: On the same phone as perf-verdict-on-device: enable VoiceOver (iOS) / TalkBack (Android), then run the core tour by gesture alone — select an ayah, open the rail, hop, walk back along the beads.
tunes: apps/web/e2e/share-a11y.spec.ts — any announcement that is wrong or missing becomes an assertion there
packages/core/src/highlighter.ts — the aria-label shape, if the labels read badly

checks.title: Read the Complex's published terms at the source
checks.why: SOURCES.md currently reads KFGQPC's terms through quran-svg's NOTICE.md, which quotes them verbatim and cites Royal Decrees 136/8 and 9/B/46356 — strong, but secondary. The app states those terms to every reader in the colophon, and an earlier paraphrase of them was wrong.
checks.how: Open qurancomplex.gov.sa in an ordinary browser. It refuses connections from this environment (ECONNREFUSED on /en/ and /en/terms/) and web.archive.org is not fetchable from the tooling. Confirm the wording still says free digital/web/software use with commercial printing reserved.
tunes: SOURCES.md §hafs-kfqc — drops the 'pending-that-glance' clause from the Status line
apps/web/src/components/Colophon.tsx — the mushaf licence line, if the wording moved

checks.title: The GPL §6 offer resolves for a stranger
checks.why: Publishing a static PWA conveys it: the browser receives real copies of the JS and of assets/roots/**, a GPL-covered derivative. The colophon links SOURCE_REPO at the exact build commit, which discharges the obligation only if that URL opens for someone who is not signed in as us.
checks.how: Open the colophon's source link in a private/logged-out browser window against the deployed build. It must land on real source, at a commit, not a 404.
tunes: apps/web/src/provenance.ts — SOURCE_REPO, if the source is served from somewhere other than the GitHub repo

checks.title: Edge spot-audit — 20 random edges against a printed mushaf
checks.why: The data is scripture. Every automated gate here proves the shards are well-formed; none can prove an edge is true. This is the only check that can, and it is the one whose results are worth the most per minute spent.
checks.how: Draw 20 edges at random from the shipped shards, look each pair up in a printed mushaf, and judge whether they are genuinely mutashabihat. Record every verdict — correct AND wrong — in packages/etl/data/qa/verified-edges.json.
tunes: packages/etl/data/qa/verified-edges.json — every verdict becomes a permanent gate assertion via gate:verified-edges
packages/etl/scripts/build-adjacency.mjs — a systematic class of wrong edge becomes a filter, not 20 more rejections

checks.title: 8+ day offline survival, installed vs browser tab
checks.why: Safari's ITP deletes all script storage for origins untouched for 7 days of browser use, and Home-Screen-installed apps are exempt. That single asymmetry is why the install prompt is a feature and not a nicety — and it has never been observed, only read about.
checks.how: Pin a juz in both an installed PWA and a Safari tab. Leave both for 8+ days of normal browser use. Then go into airplane mode and try to revise the pinned juz in each.
tunes: apps/web/e2e/offline.spec.ts — the eviction-detection path gets asserted against what actually happened
apps/web/src/storage.ts — the re-pin offer's trigger, if eviction looks different than assumed
